name: NICE aligns type 2 diabetes drug guidance
headline: NICE updates four type 2 diabetes appraisals and withdraws four dapagliflozin appraisals
summary: NICE has updated four technology appraisals on type 2 diabetes medicines to match its type 2 diabetes guideline, and withdrawn four on dapagliflozin.
keyPoints: On 15 September 2026 NICE published a news story on updating four technology appraisals for type 2 diabetes.
The updated appraisals were brought into line with NICE's guideline on type 2 diabetes in adults.
NICE describes the exercise as the first test of a new way of keeping all of its guidance aligned.

body.heading: What was announced
body.body: NICE has updated four technology appraisals for type 2 diabetes medicines so that they match the recommendations in its guideline on type 2 diabetes in adults. NICE says the pilot shows that appraisals can be kept aligned with guidelines more efficiently, without compromising the rigour or transparency of its decisions.

body.heading: What it means
body.body: NICE also withdrew four appraisals on dapagliflozin: TA288, TA390, TA418 and TA583. It treats the withdrawal as a routing decision, and says it is not subject to appeal. NICE describes the exercise as the first test of a new way of keeping all of its guidance aligned.

source.title: Faster alignment of technology appraisals with clinical guidelines trialled in type 2 diabetes update
